desc:
Hunt adorable pets across floating islands, collect their cards and become the strongest hunter!

⚔️ Hunt & Level Up - Pick your class and explore themed islands up to Lv 99. Fight yourself or turn on AUTO HUNT!
🃏 Collect Cards - Every monster can drop its own card. Slot cards into your gear to boost ATK, HP, CRIT and more.
🔨 Upgrade Gear - Upgrade equipment up to +10 and roll bonus stats for your perfect build.
👑 Bosses & Dungeons - Defeat island bosses to unlock new areas, clear dungeons, and join a WORLD BOSS every 30 minutes!
🐶 Pets & Mounts - Tame pets, ride mounts and earn titles.
🤝 Party Up - Hunt with friends and share EXP.
🏰 GUILDS - Team up with friends, level up your guild, build a Guild House for EXP, Drop & Gold boosts, beat the weekly Guild Boss and climb the guild board for prizes!

👍 Like & ⭐ Favorite for updates!
* 500 Likes for special Code.
